page.title: Colors & fonts
page.description: How your menu looks: the colours your design lets you change, and a font for each language.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: The colours {{design}} lets you change. Each design keeps its own, so switching designs and back brings yours back.
colors.none: {{design}} has a fixed look: it has no colours to change.
colors.contrast: Hard to read on {{partner}}. Try a lighter or darker shade.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: One font for each writing system your menu uses. Languages that share letters share a font. A tap saves it.
